blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Army effectively covers only 40 to 50 percent of the country, and its limited reach is insufficient even for logistical operations, according to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. Teodoro said the military needs additional strategic bases to address gaps in the country’s defense capabilities. “We also need to build our strategic naval, army, and air force bases because the army coverage, army, which is the most substantial in terms of personnel and locations, covers effectively about only 40 percent to 50 percent of the archipelago, which is not enough, even for logistics purposes,” he said in an […]...
